added_failures_note: derived from the reviewed run's own gate logs: base logs/base-orderA-1.log (rev e7eca9f0) and after logs/fixed-orderA-1.log (rev 3a7781da) each end "4 passed" with no FAILED/ERROR line, so the set difference over pytest node ids is zero. The reviewed manifest names its base and after logs under test_logs, not the baseline_suite/after_suite fields the read-time annotation reads, so read_review annotates this run unmeasured.

findings.text: the teardown ends by assigning serve._SIGNATURE_TTL_S = 0.0 with no assertion, so the done-when's named teardown check ("fails the server test if serve._SIGNATURE_TTL_S is not 0.0") is absent at head; a regression that removes only this restore leaves the 60.0 memo in place and no in-repo test reddens, because the unmodified base arms also ran 4 passed.

the base arm's command omits the memoprobe plugin, so it records only "4 passed" and neither the tag-inventory outcome nor the serve._SIGNATURE_TTL_S value the done-when required each base run to log; the base failure did not reproduce and the manifest never says so.

the manifest presents the modified scratch tree /tmp/asm-repro-base, whose write is deferred until after server.serve_forever() returns, as the base fixture reproducing the defect, while the done-when required measuring the node's own base (e7eca9f0) and this run's own base arms passed.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base e7eca9f0 - 83f453e2 adds _THREAD_STOP_S, the join and the thread-alive assertion in _ServedEntryPoint.stop() and takes the memo assignment off monkeypatch; 3a7781da removes a teardown assertion that compared the memo with the 0.0 it had just assigned; e9f88016 adds the evidence fragment; no product source is touched.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names base and after runs of both files in one process, in both orders, three and five times each, each base run logging the tag-inventory outcome and the _SIGNATURE_TTL_S value after the server fixtures' teardown, a teardown check that fails the server test when the memo is not 0.0, an executed red control and no deleted assertion; the manifest records the five-by-five fixed arms and a scratch control, but the base arms at logs/base-orderA-1.log log neither quantity, the base failure did not reproduce, and the teardown check the done-when names is absent at head.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to contain the served-entry-point test's discovery memo write within its own test so no later test in the same process reads a live memo, and tests/test_server_listens_before_it_watches.py:119-125 joins the served thread (bounded by _THREAD_STOP_S) before teardown returns while :206-212 restores serve._SIGNATURE_TTL_S after that join, so the write is ordered inside the test.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it names commits 83f453e2, 3a7781da and e9f88016 (each resolves under git cat-file -t) and the mechanism at reckon/serve.py:3397-3399, but it presents the modified scratch tree /tmp/asm-repro-base as the base fixture and never records that the node's own base arms passed.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares tests/test_server_listens_before_it_watches.py, the evidence fragment and a figures directory; git diff e7eca9f0..e9f88016 touches only the test file and the fragment, both inside the declared scope, and git diff e7eca9f0..e9f88016 over reckon/ is empty so no product source changed.

justifications.durability: the join plus tests/test_server_listens_before_it_watches.py:121 assert not self.thread.is_alive() reddens when the join is removed (the control ends 1 failed, 3 passed, 3 errors), but the memo restore at :212 is a bare assignment with no assertion and the done-when's teardown check is absent, so a regression that drops only the restore leaks undetected.
justifications.evidence: the fixed arms at logs/fixed-orderA-1.log log the probe teardown ttl=60.0 then 0.0 and end 4 passed in both orders, but the base arms at logs/base-orderA-1.log omit the memoprobe and record only "4 passed", so the two quantities the done-when required each base run to log were never taken and the base failure did not reproduce.
justifications.fit: the fixture change follows the surrounding idiom at tests/test_server_listens_before_it_watches.py:151 and introduces no name the repository naming rules forbid.
